'''Kyle George''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 7th at [[August 2001 Cincinnati tournament]] on 25 August 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|PodProfit]], according to Alex George's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2891">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-cincinnati-oh-8-25-01d2891/ cincinnati-oh-8-25-01], DeckTech (Alex "george3785" George, 25 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-cincinnati-oh-8-25-01d2891/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
